The '''Battle of Kes''' was a confrontation that took place in [[16,921 BBY]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds']] [[Kes system/Legends|Kes system]]. The [[Star system/Legends|system]] was situated on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Axis]], between the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Alsakan system/Legends|Alsakan systems]].<ref name="EGTW" />

During the [[First Alsakan Conflict]], the first of a fourteen-[[Millennium/Legends|millennia]]-long [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|series]] of wars over [[Politics/Legends|political]] control of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] between its [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the planet [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]], and their respective allies, [[Realspace/Legends|space]] between Coruscant and Alsakan was strown with [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Mine/Legends|minefields]], and it was there that the Battle of Kes was fought nearly [[17,018 BBY|one hundred]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the commencement of the war. The battle became the only direct confrontation during the early Alsakan Conflicts between the forces of the two belligerent systems. The engagement resulted in a tactical draw, and the First Alsakan Conflict continued for more than [[16,700 BBY|two centuries]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Kes was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" />
